correctness.rationale: For Haar rank-k real orthogonal projectors, P11 has Beta(k/2,(n-k)/2) law; irreducible stabilizer sectors of real symmetric traceless coefficients have dimensions 1, n−1, (n−2)(n+1)/2. The axial/cross/tangential conditional second moments in the frozen proof correctly give three normalized quadratic Beta weights W_A,W_C,W_T; integrating their differences gives exact affine-crossing factors with t_AC=k/n, t_AT=[k(n+2)−2n]/[n(n−2)], t_CT=(n−k−1)/(n−2). Independently checked all three symbolic density difference/derivative identities using SymPy, and complement symmetry at n=2k proves T_(1/2)=I/2. The proof handles k=1,n−1 boundaries without assuming interior-rank threshold order.
